flags.why: The common meaning referring to menstruation, as in có kinh or trễ kinh, is missing.
Calling someone đần is derogatory, and the informal tag does not warn the learner of this.
The common meaning of combining separate things into one, as in nhập hai nhóm lại, is missing.
flags.fix: to merge; to combine into one

flags.why: The common physical meaning of uncomfortable tightness or pressure, as in tức ngực or tức bụng, is missing.
flags.fix: to feel uncomfortable tightness or pressure (especially in the chest or abdomen)
